items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Ervin Butler, sure enough, comes and get us. We started right at the corner of the house.

ctx.x: that place into a baza(?)! A humbug!

So I named the group the Boozaire(?) Kings. So Ervin Butler, sure enough, comes and get us. We started right at the corner of the house. We played out on the side of the street by the bar, by the door. We played ..[SINGS REFRAIN] Charlie Costain(?) sang "Apple pie ..[INAUDIBLE].." [SYNCOPATING] Man, all the people come out the barroom to see this music, because they're used to itinerant... Then they say, "You'all can come on in here." So they send us some money. So we made about fifty cents. Well, then Butler got…
We made like two dollars a piece. Men was makin' like ten dollars a week and raising their family!
